grid.core: abs(x)<=0.25:51 sampled centers[-0.25,+0.25] in fixed common core [4303.5375,4304.0375]Angstrom, distinct from exact individual original cores; no fitted linewidth.

normalization.rule: Per profile and frame, pooled signed median of native samples with 1.5<=abs(frame offset)<=3, requiring at least 20 finite samples separately in each flank and a positive pooled median. No fitted background, continuum or line model.
normalization.missing: Zero native left/right coverage is MISSING_LEFT/RIGHT_FLANK_COVERAGE; insufficient finite counts are separate. Invalid or nonpositive references keep raw-only arrays and block normalized RMS. No moved flanks, sign flip, shrink or extrapolation.
normalization.context: Separate left/right native and finite counts, medians and nonpositive fractions; available median distinct from valid reference; signed-window nonpositive fraction and positive finite ERR coverage. Native BUNIT unspecified; merged ADU verified.
normalization.noise: First-difference 1.4826 MAD / sqrt(2) of finite adjacent source samples with both endpoints in the same fixed flank and spacing <=1.51 times median step. Never bridge flanks or gaps. Descriptive low-reference flag median<=3*proxy only if reference valid; no formal SNR.
normalization.structured_neighbor: Retain every fixed-flank source sample and spectral structure without masks or assumed line-free regions. Original C016 epoch/raw evidence and same-target observations already exist. Pooled medians are descriptive levels, not fitted or established line-free continua; no quality outcome is inherited from C011.

comparisons.merged: 7 own-target epochs × 4 distinct fixed discovery references × 2frames × 2regions = 112 records, including 16 identical-product self rows. Retain every reference, every cross-discovery direction and every dependency flag.
comparisons.native: 4 native covering-order contexts × 2frames × 2regions = 16 same-exposure native-to-merged records. Native profiles compare only with their own-exposure merged product, not all four discovery references; shared extraction is dependent.
comparisons.statistics: Unshifted raw Pearson requires at least ceil(.8*Nregion) common finite raw samples and nonzero exact range. Normalized RMS requires that support in common finite normalized samples. Raw-only profiles block normalized RMS but retain adequately covered raw Pearson. Counts and reasons remain explicit.
comparisons.self_and_dependency_flags: Retain same_exposure and identical_product_self_pair flags for all four fixed references and seven reused HD114386 products. Cross-discovery pairs and both directional rows are dependent; multiple reference comparisons are not independent detections or additional observations.
comparisons.per_reference_nonself_accounting: Six other epochs per reference and frame/region. Four references yield 24 ordered nonself rows per frame/region reusing seven observations; reciprocal cross-discovery rows are dependent,not 24 independent epochs.
